content.thinking: Yesterday was 2026-01-06. Now let me search through all these repos for commits from that date by the user. I need to get more repos (the list was cut at 50) and then query each one for commits.

input.command:
cd ~/git && for repo in $(find . -name ".git" -type d -maxdepth 4 2>/dev/null); do
  dir=$(dirname "$repo")
  commits=$(git -C "$dir" log --oneline --after="2026-01-05" --before="2026-01-07" --author="$(git config user.email)" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$commits" ]; then
    echo "=== $dir ==="
    git -C "$dir" log --pretty=format:"%h %s" --after="2026-01-05" --before="2026-01-07" --author="$(git config user.email)" 2>/dev/null
    echo -e "\n"
  fi
done
